set.name: Shay
set.mechanism: Imigongo, the Rwandan relief art of nested black, white and ochre bands: the mark is an Amatana diamond drawn in the same bands, the captions are tall caps set as calmly as those bands, and the palette is chocolate, caramel, olive and oat.
set.expression_move: One Imigongo motif per post, cropped at an edge; type and colour stay quiet.
set.differs_by: The reference creators rely on caption type alone; this adds a pattern language with Shay's own roots, which none of them can borrow.

logo.concept: An Amatana diamond from Imigongo: two nested bands around a caramel core, next to SHAY in calm tall caps.

misuse.label: Don't turn the diamond into a square

defaults_used.why: Shay picked olive and oat in the vibe round; oat is that choice.
Shay picked chocolate and caramel in the vibe round; caramel also stands in for Imigongo's red ochre.

rationale.claim: Shay chose the Imigongo zigzag border and the Amatana, Ngondo and Itweka motifs from a reference of Rwandan Imigongo panels.
Shay chose warm-clean and moody-warm feeds, chocolate/caramel and olive/oat, tall sporty caps and a chill energy level (2 of 5).
Nested bands with equal stroke and gap stay readable at avatar size when reduced to one ring and the core.

palette.name: Shay
palette.direction: Chocolate and caramel on oat, olive for second surfaces, night for moody photos.

brand.name: Caramel
brand.usage: the diamond core, borders, one highlight per post
